sources.used_for: ROS time fallback/activation, zero before initialization, pause and jump notifications; not evidence that the project ran those paths.

Installed JumpThreshold requires negative nonzero min_backward; callback must be nonblocking. TimeSource best-effort depth1 subscription and last_time_set cache persist across activation toggles. Hashes are in environment_inventory.json.
LOCALHOST branch adds SHM and UDP transports; SYSTEM_DEFAULT leaves middleware transport profile configuration in place. Exact package version alone does not prove binary/source equivalence.
SYSTEM_DEFAULT for XML discovery configuration, FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE, default RMW DataSharing OFF and XML QoS override controls.
SYSTEM_DEFAULT is a recognized discovery-range value; local headers agree with this enum.
Interface whitelist and explicit user transport/builtin transport controls; served docs currently2.14.7, localbinary2.14.6 requires actual profile/runtime validation.

documentation_limit: docs.ros.org Jazzy clock/discovery pages returned access-denied; installed source and version-tagged upstream code used instead. No claim of a successful online API-doc read.
governing_requirements: T0-H REVIEW.md explicitly leaves actual ROS use_sim_time and jump tests outstanding
